title: [v0.92][planning] Establish the v0.92.1 corporate, C-SDLC v3, and distributed Runtime milestone
body:
Closes #146

- establish the canonical planning-only v0.92.1 milestone package
- preserve 42 complete work-package specifications for corporate/IP transfer, C-SDLC v3, distributed Runtime qualification, and the integration/closeout tail
- make post-merge operator bootstrap responsible for creating WP-01; WP-01 then exclusively creates and validates the downstream live issue wave

- preserve all 721 generated cards, designs, diagrams, validators, and proof stubs byte-for-byte in a source-commit-anchored, explicitly non-authoritative planning archive
